newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel battered not beaten by crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel battered not beaten by crude.

text.p: Low sulphur straight run was battered by falling crude on Tuesday. Prices fared better than other fuel oil, essentially because there was only limited supplies. Set against this there was muted buying interest. A 20,000 tonne parcel that has been threatening to overhang the market sold yesterday to a major at around $143. Strong buying interest from Scandinavia has led to material being offered privately.
The continuing question of Russian export tariffs has eased as have the number of cargoes available. Traders said E-4 has been talked flat to the formula. -- London +44 171 542 8980
